interpretation.explicitlyCoined: Exactly five terms have an explicit coinage claim in the archived lexical audit. The first source is a dated RCA paper, but absence of earlier indexed phrasing is not universal priority proof.
interpretation.wctDefined: A term/construction named or specialized within Reyes's publication corpus. This does NOT say the underlying scientific term or mathematical method is original.
interpretation.exactPhraseSurvivor: No earlier indexed occurrence of the exact phrase was located by the bounded audit. This is NOT a measurement of physical originality, correctness, or adoption.
interpretation.establishedExternal: Background terms are intentionally excluded from the authored-terms attribution registry.
interpretation.paperLevelOverlap: External evidence ledger comparisons do NOT imply a later researcher read, borrowed, cited, or adopted any particular glossary term.
interpretation.lexicallyUnaudited2026Terms: The additional terms from releases 23–28 have source publication anchors but were NOT part of the archived exact-phrase priority audit.
